messages.subject: spec for ODE functions & solvers
parts:
Here's the signature (feel free to change arguments):

template <typename F, typename T1, typename T2>
promote_args<T1,T2>::value
solve_ode(F f, // system function
double t0, // initial time (double)
const Matrix<double,Dynamic,1>& ts, // solution times (double)
const Matrix<T1,Dynamic,1>& theta, // parameters (var, double)
const Matrix<T2,Dynamic,1>& y0, // initial state (var, double)
const Matrix<double,Dynamic,1>& x, // data (double)
const std::vector<int>& x_int); // data (int)


Then the function F is going to look like foo, that returns
dy/dt as a vector:

Matrix<promote_args<T1,T2>::value, Dynamic, 1>
foo(double t, // time (double)
const Matrix<T1,Dynamic,1>& y, // state (var,double)
const Matrix<T2,Dynamic,1>& theta, // parameters (var,double)
const Matrix<double,Dynamic,1>& x, // data (double)
const std::vector<int>& x_int); // data (real)

- Bob
